parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The identifier of the request source. Set the value to **sas**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The vertex type. Set the value to **SAS_INCIDENT** for security alerts.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the server to query.

parameters.name: VertexId
parameters.description: The vertex ID. You can obtain this value from the AlarmUniqueInfo parameter returned by the [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) operation.
